text:
billing_ops: Discovered gap in last week's revenue numbers: Stripe shows $8,200 refunds, report shows $4,800. ~3.4k missing.

stripe_bot: stripe_event: refund.refunded id=refund_1KxA amount=115000 created=2026-03-18T19:02:44Z metadata={"invoice":"INV-2026-0870"}

finance_engineer: Possible cause: reconciled_refunds aggregation collapses partial refunds by original charge and uses max() instead of sum().

eng_infra: Found bug in /services/reporting/refunds_agg.py: GROUP BY original_charge_id SELECT max(refund_amount). I'll open hotfix PR to change to sum() and add unit test for multiple partials.

acct_mgr: Collections paused for INV-2026-0870, INV-2026-0922, INV-2026-0931. Will hold outreach until backfill completes.

netsuite_bot: ns_sync: refund_1KxA -> mapped to ns_creditmemo CM-2026-2107 mapped_by=stripe_refund_id

finance_engineer: Backfill plan: run upsert backfill to reconciled_refunds using stripe_refund_id as key, then re-run weekly report. Dry-run first: ./bin/backfill_refunds --from 2026-03-15 --to 2026-03-22 --dry-run

cfo: Please include estimated impact to ARR and MRR in follow-up.

eng_infra: PR opened and deploying to staging. I'll post backfill dry-run output when ready.

billing_ops: Thanks everyone. tagging @acct_mgr @cfo. :white_check_mark:
